name: Boutmon
main_effect: [Your Turn] When this Digimon would digivolve into a card with the [Shaman] or [Wizard] trait, you may trash up to 3 cards from the top of your security stack. For each security card trashed by this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
source_effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 3 security cards, unsuspend this Digimon.
